posts.title: Before you book Airbnb cleaning in Greer, get this ready
posts.text:

Leave fresh linens where we can find them, since the beds are made with host-provided sheets. Put the restock supplies in one spot, such as a labeled bin in the laundry area, so the crew can check paper goods, soap and coffee against your list. Tell us about any room that needs special handling, like a delicate countertop, a smart lock code process or a closet that stays off limits.

posts.title: One tip for a move-out clean in Campobello
posts.text:
If you are moving out of a rental in Campobello, SC, here is the one tip we repeat most: start with the inside of the kitchen, not the floors. Move out cleaning in Campobello usually gets judged at the final walkthrough, and landlords open cabinets, the oven and the refrigerator first.

Empty the fridge and freezer a day early so they can warm up and be wiped clean, and take everything out of the cabinets and drawers so the inside and outside of each one can be washed. A lot of deposits are lost over a greasy range hood or a crusty oven, and both take longer than people expect, especially in farm and country homes where the kitchen sees real use.

Once the kitchen is done, the rest follows a simple order: bathrooms, closets, baseboards and door frames, window sills and tracks, then floors last, vacuumed and mopped edge to edge so nobody walks over a clean floor. Campobello sits about 13 miles from Greer off I-26 and US-176, so our team can reach most homes in the area without trouble.

posts.title: Post-construction cleaning checklist for Moore homes
posts.text:
Finishing a remodel, an addition or a new build in Moore, SC? Here is the checklist our team follows for post construction cleaning in Moore, so you know what a proper final clean covers before you move the furniture back in.

- Fine dust wiped from every surface, ledge, trim line and door casing
- Inside cabinets, drawers and closets
- Windows, glass, tracks and sills, with paint specks and sticker residue removed
- Light fixtures, vents and ceiling fans
- Bathrooms and new fixtures polished
- Floors vacuumed and washed in more than one pass
- A final touch-up walk-through before you settle in

Moore has plenty of new subdivisions south of Spartanburg, off SC-290 and I-26, and the dust from drywall and sanding gets into places you would not think to look. That is why we work in passes: the dust that settles overnight gets picked up on the next round instead of ending up on your new counters.
